question: Should assistant-message copy expose a per-copy Markdown/plain-text menu, and which structural cues should the plain-text output preserve?
rationale: This adds a user-facing interaction and export contract that current code, tests, and documentation do not define.

options.title: Add per-copy menu
options.body: Offer Markdown and plain text at copy time without introducing persisted configuration.

options.title: Keep Markdown only
options.body: Retain the current single-format action and decline the additional UI surface.

options.title: Add a default preference
options.body: Persist the copy format, accepting additional settings and compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Add per-copy menu
recommendation.body: Offer Markdown and plain text at copy time without introducing persisted configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current copy behavior and are the strongest history-backed routing candidate for this UX decision.
